Second cause found afterwards: GIN fastupdate pending list (322 pages; engine read 326 buffers/11.8 ms -> 4 buffers/0.24 ms after gin_clean_pending_list) -> migration 0005_gin_fastupdate.sql + integration test (59/59), unmeasured under the protocol (single permitted re-run used).
